patent.title: 一种碳纤维复合材料及其制备方法
assignees: 内蒙古中晶科技研究院有限公司
patent.family_note: Ordinary CN materials invention (Inner Mongolia Zhongjing / mid-tier C/C composite maker for crystal-furnace hot-field parts; not software/mech/chem samples already covered, not BYD/Huawei/award-star). Claims pitch+PAN layered CF composite via CVD carbon deposition + high-T heat treat for resistance uniformity. Do NOT inherit exact mapping from pre-filing 2019 product pages (螺杆 etc.) or from 2020-01 Phase-1 reach-capacity narrative; those are product/project layer. Do NOT inherit TCL Zhonghuan investor brand as patent-level mapping. Sibling/other Zhongjing C/C process patents must not be inherited.

knowledge_origin.description: Public sources confirm Zhongjing inventorship/assignee for this CF composite filing, but do not reconstruct whether it originated as an internal resistance-uniformity heating-material track versus a named commercial hot-field SKU retrofit.

technology.problem: CF heating / composite parts can show uneven resistance and rising cold-state resistance in use (as framed in the patent background/summary).
technology.mechanism: Claimed material: pitch-based CF and PAN-based CF at weight ratio 3–5:1, alternating layup (one pitch layer / three PAN layers), CVD carbon deposition on the preform, then high-temperature heat treatment to form the CF composite; asserted better resistance uniformity and cold-resistance stability.
technology.comparison_baseline: Conventional single-type CF / C/C layups without the claimed pitch+PAN ratio and CVD+heat-treat sequence (as described in the patent).

value_carriers.name: 中晶炭/炭热场件与加热用碳纤维复合材料（候选；映射未确认）
value_carriers.description: Public C/C hot-field product catalog and Phase-1 capacity narrative exist. Spec describes pitch+PAN layered CVD/heat-treat CF composite for resistance uniformity, but no official disclosure reviewed names ZL202010866038.2 / CN111892417B as the exact material of a commercial SKU. Pre-filing 2019 product pages and 2020-01 Phase-1 reach-capacity show product/project existence before this filing.

gaps.description: No public datasheet, regulated disclosure, customer BOM, or official Zhongjing process note reviewed names ZL202010866038.2 / CN111892417B as implemented in a commercial hot-field/heating SKU. Spec claim language ≠ E3. Pre-filing 2019 catalog and 2020-01 Phase-1 capacity must not be inherited as mapping for this 2020 material patent.
needed_evidence: Official patent–material mapping naming this application/grant number
Product datasheet or customer BOM tying pitch+PAN CVD/heat-treat claims to a SKU
Audited process note for commercial batches using the claimed layup/CVD sequence

gaps.description: Hot-field catalog and Phase-1 capacity are public at enterprise/product layer, but deployment/usage scale cannot be inherited by this exact patent without an exact-patent → carrier link.
needed_evidence: Independent verification that commercial batches use the claimed pitch+PAN process
Customer implementation proof matching claimed resistance-uniformity material

gaps.description: No public evidence attributes yield, scrap reduction, or revenue increment specifically to ZL202010866038.2. Product and capacity narratives emphasize C/C hot-field lines, not this grant number.
needed_evidence: Audited incremental value tied to this patent

gaps.description: Patent asserts resistance uniformity / cold-resistance stability vs conventional CF layups; independent reproducible plant-scale benchmarks for THIS claim set were not collected in this ordinary cold start.
needed_evidence: Claim-coverage comparison vs peer C/C or CF composite patents
Third-party evaluation of pitch+PAN CVD/heat-treat claims

notes: Ordinary (non-textbook) CN materials invention cold-start — mid-tier C/C composite firm (Inner Mongolia Zhongjing), carrier_type=material, not software/mechanical/chemical samples already done, not BYD/Huawei/award-star. Deliberately stops at R0: product/capacity E2 exists; 2019 product page and 2020-01 Phase-1 reach-capacity pre-date 2020-08-25 filing (申请日前产品/达产≈他案) — expect validate_data soft warnings, exit 0; no official E3 naming this grant. Do not inherit TCL Zhonghuan investor brand. Unknown ≠ 0. Formal methodology V0.7 / schema 1.0; V0.8 not adopted; no Counterfactual experimental schema.
